name: Free Online Word (DOCX) Compressor - ATools
description: Free online Word compressor: Intelligently compress embedded images in DOCX documents and repackage to dramatically reduce file size. Pure client-side processing.
seoDescription: Free online Word (DOCX) document compressor. Automatically discovers and resamples large embedded images, screenshots, and photos inside Word documents while preserving original formatting and text. Drastically reduces DOCX file size for easier sharing and email attachments. Runs 100% locally in your browser with zero file uploads.

ui.dropHint: Drop .docx file here or click to upload.
ui.modeBalancedDesc: Optimizes embedded high-resolution images while preserving clarity, repacking with maximum compression.
ui.modeAggressiveDesc: Heavier compression on embedded images, ideal for large docs sent via email.
ui.modeRepackOnlyDesc: Repackages the ZIP container without touching any image assets.
tips: Over 90% of a Word document (.docx) size usually comes from embedded high-res photos and screenshots;
This tool unpacks locally in your browser, resampling images without altering document text or layout;
All processing happens 100% client-side without uploading files to any server.
ui.emptyResultHint: Click “Compress Document” to get your optimized Word document
ui.errNotDocx: Please upload a Word document ending in .docx
ui.errFailed: Compression failed. Please ensure the file is a valid .docx document.
